Chapter 3 · Words I wish I could whisper

Sealed with all my love

Tap the envelope. This one's only for you, Ronahi.

My beautiful Ronahi,

It still amazes me how someone I met through a screen could become someone I care about so deeply. We haven’t taken a photo side by side or celebrated a birthday in the same room. Not yet. But every message and every moment with you already means something to me.

And there is one date I want to remember with you: July 19, 2023. Our first conversation. One ordinary day that became the beginning of something beautiful for me.

I love the little things: seeing your name appear, finding something funny and wanting to tell you first, and realizing how much brighter an ordinary day can feel after we talk. Somehow you make distance feel less important.

On your birthday, I wish you peace, happy surprises, easy laughter, and dreams that come true. I hope the coming year gives you countless reasons to smile — and I hope I get to be one of them.

Maybe one day we’ll take that first photo together. Until then, I’m grateful for the story we are already writing, one hello at a time. Happy birthday, my beautiful Ronahi. ❤️

With all my love,
Mohammed ♡
